workspace, repository, and file paths containing spaces and Unicode

junction inside the Workspace is fail-closed: escaped sibling content never appears in status or diff
GitObservationCollector real Git integration (production factory)
preserves distinct first/final HEAD SHAs across a real commit boundary
malformed HEAD output stays unavailable and is never unborn
legacy ambiguous rev-parse HEAD diagnostic stays unavailable and is never unborn evidence
missing executable maps through the controlled driver seam to not_found -> GIT_EXECUTABLE_UNAVAILABLE
unknown spawn failure maps through the controlled driver seam to frozen unknown -> GIT_COMMAND_SPAWN_FAILED
GitObservationCollector controlled seams around real command results
holds real NodeProcessDriver spawn resolution under launch budget, then arms family runtime
GitCommandAdapter real Windows launch/runtime deadline separation
deterministic timeout on a live real Git command after real handle/identity observation
deterministic cancellation of a live real Git command after real handle/identity observation
bounded_diff beyond 4 MiB maps to adapter output_limit with bounded retained stdout and proven owned-tree cleanup
bounded_diff beyond 4 MiB yields a truncated collector diff with diffBytes null and the same owned cleanup proof
porcelain_v2_status beyond 1 MiB maps to adapter output_limit with bounded retained stdout
porcelain_v2_status beyond 1 MiB is never clean or complete in the collector snapshot
>16 KiB stderr on a real owned Git command stays bounded and truncated while stdout stays intact
truncated stderr diagnostics never prove NOT_GIT and no raw diagnostic reaches the public snapshot
a truncated discovery diagnostic on a non-Git directory fails closed as UNAVAILABLE, never NOT_GIT
GitObservationCollector real Git bounds and Windows process ownership (Phase B)
real adapter + controlled unproven verification aborts collection after first HEAD, with no status/diff/final HEAD
GitObservationCollector cleanup-unproven through the real adapter (HIGH-1)
real NodeProcessDriver maps a missing git executable to not_found -> GIT_EXECUTABLE_UNAVAILABLE
